meta.name: render-myth-vs-fact
meta.description: Assemble a myth-vs-fact kinetic-typography explainer video ad (≈29.5s, 9:16) from N myth/fact pairs + hook / turn / punch copy + palette + a brand end-card PNG + a VO track — a hook, 3 red-strike MYTH cards that flip to teal-check FACT cards (per-line strikethrough that crosses EVERY wrapped line), a "what actually works" turn, an optional proof reveal, a punch line, and a static end card. DETERMINISTIC assembly with ZERO AI-gen visuals — HTML hyperframes rendered frame-exact via Playwright (`window.renderAt(t)`, animation a pure function of beat-local time), Whisper beat-snap to VO word onsets, concat at a uniform fps, karaoke `.ass` captions burned last (suppressed on the proof + end-card beats), and a VO + optional music mix (music −20 dB, `amix normalize=0`, tail fade). FREE (Python + Playwright + ffmpeg); the recipe supplies the copy / palette / end-card / VO and gates the paid VO / music / Whisper calls to their own capabilities. Use for the myth-vs-fact format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Assemble myth-vs-fact copy into kinetic-typography video ads

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的文案、配色、品牌图片和配音，自动组装一个约29.5秒、9:16竖屏的“破除迷思”科普视频广告。视频包含：开头钩子、3组“迷思→事实”翻转卡片、转折、可选证据展示、收尾金句和静态品牌尾板。所有画面都是确定性的HTML超帧，不使用AI生成图像或视频。
howto.when: 当你提供完整的文案（包括迷思/事实对、钩子、转折、金句）、配色方案、品牌尾板PNG和配音音频文件时触发。

say.text: 用蓝色系配色和我的品牌尾板，生成一个关于护肤迷思的科普视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用你指定的配色和品牌图片组装视频。
